ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white/cream central area contrasted against a 20% low-intensity black peripheral margin along the trailing and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white field is bifurcated by the median notch. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border. Multiple dark linear streaks (rake marks) are mapped across the medial regions of both lobes, with several small circular low-intensity spots (mottling) concentrated near the center-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct U-shaped depression at the center-bottom, appearing approximately 45 degrees at its visible apex above the water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serrations visible along the entire continuous linear boundary of both lobes; peaks show an amplitude variation of approximately 10-15 pixels relative to adjacent valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows an upward convex curve from the median notch toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, three-dimensional textured clusters (tan/grey/white pixels) located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, dark-pigmented linear disruptions (scratches) are visible across the white field; specifically, a cluster of 4-5 parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe and several crossing vertical lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent heavy encrustations (parasitic colonization) at the lateral tips and extensive rake marks across the ventral surface.
